problem: Teams need a consistent, customisable set of UI components, now also usable by AI assistants. Astryx is an open design system for React developers and their agents.

stack.frontend: React 19+ with StyleX styles; works with Next.js, Vite, Tailwind or a CDN; has a native package
stack.backend: TypeScript with Node.js scripts and a CLI, in a pnpm monorepo
stack.ai: CLI and docs designed so AI assistants and people use the same reference
stack.deploy: npm packages (@astryxdesign/core, themes, CLI), with docs, Storybook and a sandbox site

whatsNew: Themes are just CSS custom property overrides, and consumers need no build plugin or styling library. A swizzle command ejects a component's full source into your project.
